content.content: The store write interface writes node documents to the working copy: a node document under the root.
content.rationale: Reads come from jj (S2-read), but authored node content is a working-copy file that jj versions; the write is how a node's document reaches the tree jj snapshots. D1c (kpovwvyw) fixes the document and its layout, so the interface's target is the node file. S2-ifs gives the write its own reach and keeps it filesystem-only, so it neither gains jj access nor borrows the read interface's revision rule.
